explanation: This feature is active only at D1, and only when the previous trial was a1 that led to S2 through a rare transition: then it is about 9-10 if that trial was unrewarded and about 7-9 if it was rewarded, a bit weaker late in the episode (around 6, sometimes 0 after trial 85). Everywhere else it is 0, including every GO and D2 step, D1 after a common transition and D1 after a2 (that last case rarely gives about 2).
